abstract: Install, serve, tune, scale out, update and troubleshoot ExLlamaV3 (EXL3 quantization format) and its recommended server TabbyAPI, on single or multi-GPU NVIDIA (and AMD ROCm) hosts. Covers EXL3 bitrates, config.yml, model load/unload API, tensor and expert parallel, KV cache quantization, speculative decoding, tool calling and the MiaAI-Lab aarch64/DGX Spark fork. References are split by task.
